_about: AgenticScientist sprint run 'Overlord' (26 Nov): seed assembled before lock from the best candidates of the four earlier locked runs; see prompts/brief_overlord.md.

acceptance.rule: screen one seed pair; confirm with all eight paired evaluations; accept when the proxy or changed board clears the margin with a one-sided 95% lower bound, subject to board and condition loss limits

w0: SPRINT: the research phase of this run lasts about 30 minutes in total. You have ONE cycle and about 15 minutes of working time: make ONE small, self-contained change that runs first time, check it once with quick_eval, write the hypothesis and stop. A change that is not finished in time is lost. T1 selection side. The seed emits UNEDITED measured E10.5 nuclei (temporal.py EXPRESSION_STEP = False; do not switch it on, do not edit expression) chosen by kNN lineage transport blended 50/50 with the Gaussian maturity tilt, latest-stage lineage masses (cardiomyocytes ~20%), blood x0.8. Replicate 'P3MIX ... D50_OT50U_CB' (84.2 on the test): emit a 50/50 MIXTURE of plain heart-proper donors and transport-selected donors with the lineage composition balanced to the seed's masses. Every row stays a measured nucleus.

Aim: mmd_u and variogram.

w2: SPRINT: the research phase of this run lasts about 30 minutes in total. You have ONE cycle and about 15 minutes of working time: make ONE small, self-contained change that runs first time, check it once with quick_eval, write the hypothesis and stop. A change that is not finished in time is lost. Embryo geometry. The occupancy term on the test is all-or-nothing (3.7 for an unstretched earlier-bracket scaffold, 100 for public midpoint-geometry entries). Check the seed's GEOMETRY_MORPH in the scorer's own frame: with common.shape_metrics.occupancy_dice (clouds are canonicalised, so only proportions count), the morphed output must be CLOSER to the later bracket than a plain copy of the earlier bracket is, while staying close to the earlier bracket. On the E7.5/E8.0 protocol the current morph is not (Dice to the later bracket 0.716 vs 0.731 for the plain earlier copy). Fix the morph on the Dev brackets so that the canonicalised proportions (principal-axis spread shares) move from the earlier bracket's toward the later bracket's by the time fraction; exact interpolated RMS radius unchanged; coordinates only.
